title: Personal Loans Courtesy Waiver Allowances by Grade
content:
Each Personal Loans grade sets how many courtesy fee waivers a loan can receive, the on-time record a courtesy waiver needs and how long after a fee a waiver can be asked for.

## Allowances by grade

| | Grade A | Grade B | Grade C | Grade D | Grade E | Grade F | Grade G |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy waivers per loan in any rolling 12 months | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| On-time scheduled installments needed in the 12 months before the fee | 3 | 3 | 3 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Waiver request window, calendar days after the fee's assessment date | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

## Definitions

- **Courtesy waivers per 12 months**: courtesy fee waivers available per loan in any rolling 12 months (integer).
- **On-time installments needed**: scheduled installments that must have been paid on time in the 12 months before the fee for a courtesy waiver (integer).
- **Request window**: calendar days after a fee's assessment date within which a courtesy or documented-error waiver may be requested.

## Points of reading

- Grades A and B allow two courtesy waivers in a rolling 12 months; Grades C to G allow one.
- Grades D to G need twice the on-time record of Grades A to C: 6 installments rather than 3.
- The request window is the same 60 days in every grade.
